title: Dragon Boat Race
tagline: Keep the drum beat, lead twenty paddlers to the line
description: A rhythm race in real 3D. Tap in time with the drum to sync your crew, steer the river lanes, ride fast streams and race rival crews through a heat, semifinal and final. Or take the drum yourself.
howToPlay: Tap the right side when the ring closes on the drum
Perfect timing syncs the crew and speeds the boat
Drag the left thumb to steer: take streams, dodge debris
Fill the Surge ring with great hits, then fire it
Win the heat and semifinal to reach the final
